verdict.rationale: Docs show extensive API coverage for core platform functions (onboarding via API-only or hosted, Legal Entity Management API, Configuration API for balance accounts, split-transaction and chargeback APIs, managed payouts, webhooks) suggesting most UI capabilities have API equivalents. However, some flows (e.g., 'Control fees... all managed in your Adyen Dashboard') imply certain configuration remains UI-centric, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (404 on all candidate paths), undermining full AI-native parity claims. missing for 10: explicit statement of full UI/API parity, a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable schema, and confirmation that dashboard-only settings (fees, monitoring rules) are also API-configurable.
